sources.title: David M. Blei, Alp Kucukelbir, and Jon D. McAuliffe, Variational Inference: A Review for Statisticians
sources.locator: Complete 20-page article; inspected §§1, 2.2–2.4, PDF pp. 1–6, including equations (11)–(18), Algorithm 1, and Figure 1 discussion.

contents.name: ELBO as reverse-KL objective and exact log-evidence decomposition
contents.reason: The local theorem proves the full density-ratio identity under explicit support and absolute-integrability assumptions, and uses the in-run KL supplier only for nonnegativity.

contents.name: Mean-field factorization over variational factors
contents.reason: The definition states a finite product reference space and separately checks support and ELBO integrability.

contents.name: Expected-log coordinate update and coordinate ascent procedure
contents.reason: The algorithm records finite conditional-expectation, positive finite normalizer, and admissibility checks before updating.

contents.name: Exact coordinate update is an ELBO maximizer under the declared integrability conditions
contents.reason: The complete factorized-integral and relative-entropy proof is supplied locally; the source's regularity omissions are not imported.

contents.name: Correlated bivariate Gaussian mean-field variance underestimation
contents.reason: The source motivates the phenomenon; the local carrier computes the exact independent-Gaussian ELBO maximizer and variance ratio.

contents.name: CAVI local convergence and general approximation-accuracy claims
contents.reason: The pair proves single-update monotonicity only and makes no generic convergence, stationary-point, calibration, or downstream-error claim.

contents.name: ELBO as a general model-selection or calibration criterion
contents.reason: The local scale argument shows why an absolute ELBO value alone cannot bound posterior discrepancy; no general model-selection or frequentist-coverage theorem is imported.

sources.title: Michael I. Jordan, Zoubin Ghahramani, Tommi S. Jaakkola, and Lawrence K. Saul, An Introduction to Variational Methods for Graphical Models
sources.locator: Complete 51-page article; inspected §§6.1–6.3, printed pp. 213–220, PDF pp. 31–38, including the discrete Jensen lower bound, mean-field factorization, and coordinate equations.

contents.name: Reverse KL direction and variational lower bound on evidence
contents.reason: The article's discrete derivation is context; the local theorem extends the algebra to the stated measurable-density assumptions.

contents.name: Fully factorized mean-field family and coordinate optimization
contents.reason: The finite-product definition is explicit and checks admissibility after factorization.

contents.name: Mean-field coordinate updates and their model-specific equations
contents.reason: Only the expected-log update form is adopted; local existence and exact-maximization conditions are proved separately.

contents.name: Mean-field Boltzmann-machine fixed-point and message-passing formulas
contents.reason: These are discrete model-specific formulas and are not needed for the general density update.

contents.name: EM parameter-ascent and model-specific approximation-performance results
contents.reason: No parameter-learning or generic accuracy result is part of this pair.

sources.title: Ronghuo Zheng, Zhiting Hu, and Yuntian Deng, 10-708 Probabilistic Graphical Models, Lecture 13: Variational Inference II
sources.locator: Complete 9-page lecture note; inspected §§2.3.2–3.2, PDF pp. 3–6, including Jensen's ELBO derivation, mean-field factorization, and the coordinate functional update.

contents.name: Jensen derivation of the evidence lower bound
contents.reason: The carrier supplies a direct ratio proof with the plan's density-support and integrability hypotheses.

contents.name: Mean-field factorization and expected-log coordinate formula
contents.reason: The lecture's finite-dimensional derivation is context; the local theorem verifies the formula under sigma-finite product and L1 hypotheses.

contents.name: Convergence-to-local-maximum discussion and exponential-family special cases
contents.reason: The result proves an attained single-coordinate increase only; it makes no convergence or conjugacy claim.

companions.reason: The B-page examples are exact local calculations or counterexamples derived from the A-page definitions and theorem; no separate source harvest is claimed.
